title: 旗帜 — 加入塑造 Aurefold 世界的读者行列
description: 旗帜是 Aurefold 读者的聚集之地：宣誓加入，选择你的家族，在议会投票，创建你自己的角色，并在缮写室留下作品。
blocks: Everything under the Banner lives around the story — side-stories, extras, public lore, and the archive's next opening. The central plot, canon, and character fates stay the author's. New voices are read by the archivist before they show.
旗帜之下的一切都生长在故事周围——番外、额外内容、 公开设定，以及档案馆的下一次开启。主线、正典与角色命运仍属于作者。 新的声音会先经档案员阅读，然后才会显示。
Content note. Aurefold is a mature series intended for adult readers — discussion and reader material may touch graphic violence and other adult themes.
内容提示。Aurefold 是面向成年读者的成熟系列——讨论与读者内容可能涉及直白的暴力及其他成人主题。

Where readers stop being readers. Swear in, choose the house you would follow,
      and take your place in the company that shapes the world around the book.

在这里，读者不再只是读者。宣誓，选择你愿追随的家族，
      在塑造书外世界的同伴中占据一席之地。
In the hall already: Yara Cobbleworth of Stormrider, Corin Farrow of Ashbourne, and Old Ferro of Ironvale — sworn and honoured.
大厅中已有：Stormrider 的 Yara Cobbleworth、Ashbourne 的 Corin Farrow、Ironvale 的 Old Ferro——已宣誓，已受荣。
Lately: the theory “Why the Chronicle and the Ash Fragments Can't Both Be Lying,” and the story “A Night at the Toll House.”
近来：理论《Why the Chronicle and the Ash Fragments Can't Both Be Lying》与故事《A Night at the Toll House》。
Raise a character of your own, sworn to a house — the finest are honoured, the very finest taken into the material.
创造属于你的角色，宣誓效忠一个家族——最好的会受到荣誉，最出色的会被纳入作品素材。
Standing now: “Which house would you follow?” and “Which house's fragment does the archive read aloud next?”
正在进行：“Which house would you follow?” 与 “Which house's fragment does the archive read aloud next?”
Vote on what the archive opens next — the great questions ask for a signed-in voice.
投票决定档案馆接下来开启什么——重大问题需要登录后的声音。
Leave a story, a theory, a piece of art, or a question for the author.
留下一个故事、一种理论、一件艺术作品，或一个想问作者的问题。
